info.title: Delta-Neutral Vault API
info.description: Read API over the delta-neutral ERC-4626 vault running against LOCAL MOCK MARKETS (no real funds). Money is in human units (USD numbers, ETH numbers), ratios in basis points, rates as fractions. `blockTimestamp` / `ts` fields are chain time: the demo warps time to build history.

blockTimestamp.description: Chain time (unix s). The local demo warps time, so this is the simulated clock.

tvlUsd.description: Total assets: idle USDC + strategy NAV

operational.description: false while the oracle is unhealthy and positions are open

netApy.description: Realised, annualised share-price growth over the trailing 30 days (fraction)

grossApy.description: Realised carry (lending + funding) / average TVL before costs and fees

estimatedNetApy.description: Forward-looking estimate at current rates (simulator estimation engine)

netDeltaBps.description: Integer bps of total NAV, as the contracts compute it (truncated toward zero)

totalPnlUsd.description: Strategy PnL net of vault fees
